senses.gloss: ahi-daṇḍa (IE 8-5; EI 12, 28, 33), professional tax levied from snake-charmers or levy for their maintenance.

a-hiraṇya-dhānya-praṇaya-pradeya (EI 26), refers to the freedom of the gift land from the payment of revenue in cash, the king's grain share and the benevolence or emergency imposts. Cf. Prakrit a-hiraṇṇa-dhaṇṇa-ppaṇaya-ppadeya (Select Inscriptions, pp. 408-09).
